author: Corridor Crew
description:
OK Go is a band famous for their incredibly creative and elaborate music videos. For their 2025 single, Love, they went the extra mile, choreographing 29 robotic arms provided by Universal Robots, combined with 60 mirrors, all captured in a single shot filmed in a Budapest train station.

The video was co-directed by Damian Kulash, Aaron Duffy, and Miguel Espada (who also programmed the robots), and took 39 takes over two days to finally nail the choreography.
title: They shot this PRACTICALLY and in ONE SHOT!
